title: dupatya planifolia
intro: Dupatya planifolia, commonly known as Kola nut, is a tropical evergreen tree native to Africa and Asia. It is valued for its seeds, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries to promote digestive health and reduce stress. The health benefits of Dupatya planifolia include reducing anxiety and stress, improving cognitive function, and alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including caffeine, theobromine, and theobinine, which exhibit stimulant, diuretic, and antispasmodic properties.
